articles.title: Supreme Court Says Mail Ballots Can Flow Normally for Midterms
articles.summary: The Supreme Court rejected President Trump's plan to let the Postal Service decide who gets mail ballots. Election officials can now send ballots as planned, just in time for the midterm elections.

articles.title: Can China Help Make Peace Between Iran and the U.S.?
articles.summary: Iran's foreign minister is heading to Beijing on Wednesday to meet China's top diplomat. China says it wants to be a neutral peacemaker, but experts wonder if it will really step in.

articles.title: Senate to Vote on Crypto Rules — and Trump's Billions
articles.summary: The Senate votes Tuesday on new rules for cryptocurrency, a $2.3 trillion market. Democrats want strong ethics safeguards to stop President Trump from profiting, but Republicans say the bill is needed to protect consumers.
